bridge_functions.name: DeviceUtils.GetInsets
bridge_functions.description: Get device system bar insets (status bar, navigation bar heights in dp)

bridge_functions.name: DeviceUtils.PickFile
bridge_functions.description: Launch the system file picker via SAF; fires FileSelected or FilePickCancelled event asynchronously

bridge_functions.name: DeviceUtils.CopyToStorage
bridge_functions.description: Copy a SAF content URI into app-private internal storage; returns destination path and size

bridge_functions.name: DeviceUtils.RequestPermissions
bridge_functions.description: Request one or more dangerous Android runtime permissions via the system dialog; fires PermissionsResult event asynchronously

bridge_functions.name: SmartCamera.Open
bridge_functions.description: Open the camera overlay. mode='scan' continuously detects barcodes/QR codes and fires ScanResult; mode='photo' shows a shutter button and fires PhotoCaptured.

bridge_functions.name: SmartCamera.Close
bridge_functions.description: Dismiss the camera overlay if it is currently open.

bridge_functions.name: SmartCamera.Warm
bridge_functions.description: Pre-warm CameraX in the background (no UI shown) so a later SmartCamera.Open binds the camera faster. Fire-and-forget.

bridge_functions.name: SmartCamera.Pending
bridge_functions.description: Photos taken or picked that the page has not acknowledged yet (survives the app being killed)

bridge_functions.name: SmartCamera.Take
bridge_functions.description: Read one waiting photo as base64; it stays until Ack

bridge_functions.name: SmartCamera.Ack
bridge_functions.description: Delete a waiting photo once the page has used it

bridge_functions.name: DeviceUtils.SetBackIntercept
bridge_functions.description: Send Android's Back button to the page as a BackPressed event (enabled=true) or give it back (enabled=false)
